test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Nov, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following neighbouring countries of India is most populous?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Pakistan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pakistan** is the **most populous neighbouring country of India**, with a population exceeding **240 million** (as per recent estimates).
 
• It is located to the **west of India** and shares a **3,323 km border** with India, which includes the famous **Radcliffe Line**.
 
• The country is officially known as the **Islamic Republic of Pakistan** and was established on **14th August 1947**.
 
• Pakistan consists of **four provinces**: Punjab, Sindh, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, and Balochistan, along with federally administered territories.
 
• The capital city of Pakistan is **Islamabad**, while its largest city is **Karachi**.
 
• Pakistan has a **diverse geography**, including mountains, deserts, and coastal areas, which contribute to its large population concentration.
 
• The country has a **majority Muslim population** and is a member of international organizations such as the **United Nations**, **SAARC**, and the **OIC**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Bangladesh**__

 __
 
• **Bangladesh** is located to the **east of India** and shares a **4,096.7 km border** with India, which is the **longest international border India shares with any country**.
 
• The country has a population of over **170 million**, making it the **second most populous neighbouring country** of India.
 
• It is known for its **riverine geography** with major rivers like the **Padma, Meghna, and Jamuna**.
 
 
 
• **Afghanistan**__
 __
 
• **Afghanistan** is located to the **north-west of India** and shares a **106 km border** with India in the **Wakhan Corridor**.
 
• It has a population of approximately **40 million**.
 
• The country is known for its **rugged mountainous terrain** and is often referred to as the **"Graveyard of Empires."**
 
 
 
• **Bhutan**__
 
 
• **Bhutan** is a small landlocked country located to the **north-east of India**.
 
• It has a population of around **800,000**, making it the **least populous neighbouring country** of India.
 
• Bhutan is known for its **Gross National Happiness (GNH)** index and its emphasis on **environmental conservation**.
